prompt.en: Ask the animals what they saw.

hint1.en: Look again. Where would that animal be?
hint1.ar: اُنْظُرْ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى. أَيْنَ يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ الحَيَوَان؟

hint2.en: It is one of these two.

model.en: This one. Touch it and it will tell you.

success.en: Three watchers, three clues. Well done!

payload._comment: The three correct answers - monkey, bird, fish - are the three watchers the child meets again in the counting and sorting nodes. Distractors are drawn from animals that appear nowhere else in this Adventure, so a wrong tap is never a half-right one that muddles the cast.

prompt.en: Who was watching from the high branches?
prompt.ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُرَاقِبُ مِنَ الأَغْصَانِ العَالِيَة؟

revealLine.en: The monkey says: something green flew past the tall trees.
revealLine.ar: يَقُولُ القِرْد: شَيْءٌ أَخْضَرُ طَارَ بِجَانِبِ الأَشْجَارِ العَالِيَة.

prompt.en: Who was flying above the leaves?

revealLine.en: The bird says: it came down near the wide leaves.
revealLine.ar: يَقُولُ الطَّائِر: لَقَدْ نَزَلَ قُرْبَ الأَوْرَاقِ العَرِيضَة.

prompt.en: Who was watching from the river?

revealLine.en: The fish says: it landed low, where the leaves are widest.
revealLine.ar: تَقُولُ السَّمَكَة: لَقَدْ حَطَّتْ فِي الأَسْفَل، حَيْثُ الأَوْرَاقُ أَعْرَض.
